violations.text: Several food items in the Cold Drawer Unit directly below the turbo ovens were observed held at 43-52 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per the PIC, food items were stocked just prior to opening. Food items were moved to colder refrigeration at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

The cold drawer unit located directly below the turbo ovens was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 45-46 F with food items at 43-52 F. Unit is to remain out of service until serviced/repaired and holding a proper ambient temperature of 41 degrees F for cold holding. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety that is registered/licensed with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Application printed for the PIC at the time of inspection. PIC is to submit application as soon as possible. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2024
Food items were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2024

At the time of inspection, PIC could not provide proof that the establishment employs a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety with RIDOH Center for Food Protection at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 12/25/2023
